```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      cache = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

# Purpose

The Stage 4 rolling windows all fall in spring--summer 2015, so the December
sales peak, the strongest seasonal pattern in the data, is never in a holdout.
This file adds a fourth window that covers December 2014. Its training set is all
data up to late November 2014, so the model has seen one previous December
(2013) and is asked to forecast the next one (2014). It is a direct test of
whether the boosted models generalise the Christmas peak. The pipeline matches
the rest of the thesis (no-lag features, XGBoost/LightGBM with temporal-validation
early stopping, against the two store-level baselines).

# 1. Packages, data, pipeline

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(xgboost); library(lightgbm)
TRAIN_CSV <- "train.csv"; STORE_CSV <- "store.csv"
VAL_FRAC <- 0.15; SEED <- 42
N_THREADS <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L); set.seed(SEED)
```

```{r load}
train_raw <- read_csv(TRAIN_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
store_raw <- read_csv(STORE_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- train_raw %>% filter(Open == 1, Sales > 0) %>% left_join(store_raw, by = "Store") %>%
  mutate(Year=year(Date), Month=month(Date), Week=isoweek(Date), DayOfMonth=mday(Date),
         Quarter=quarter(Date), IsWeekend=as.integer(DayOfWeek %in% c(6,7)),
         StateHoliday=case_when(StateHoliday=="a"~1L,StateHoliday=="b"~2L,StateHoliday=="c"~3L,TRUE~0L),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=ifelse(!is.na(CompetitionOpenSinceYear)&!is.na(CompetitionOpenSinceMonth),
           (Year-CompetitionOpenSinceYear)*12+(Month-CompetitionOpenSinceMonth),NA_real_),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=pmax(CompetitionOpenMonths,0,na.rm=TRUE),
         StoreType=as.integer(factor(StoreType,levels=c("a","b","c","d"))),
         Assortment=as.integer(factor(Assortment,levels=c("a","b","c")))) %>%
  mutate(CompetitionDistance=replace_na(CompetitionDistance, median(CompetitionDistance,na.rm=TRUE)),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=replace_na(CompetitionOpenMonths,0)) %>%
  arrange(Date, Store)
FEAT <- c("Store","DayOfWeek","Promo","StateHoliday","SchoolHoliday","StoreType","Assortment",
          "CompetitionDistance","Promo2","Year","Month","Week","DayOfMonth","Quarter",
          "IsWeekend","CompetitionOpenMonths")
cat("data range:", as.character(min(df$Date)), "to", as.character(max(df$Date)), "\n")
```

```{r pipeline}
eval_rmse <- function(a,p) sqrt(mean((a-p)^2))
delta_rel <- function(ref,x) (ref-x)/ref*100

# split by an explicit test window [start,end]; train = everything before start
split_window <- function(data, feats, start, end) {
  start <- as.Date(start); end <- as.Date(end)
  tr <- data %>% filter(Date < start)
  te <- data %>% filter(Date >= start, Date <= end)
  list(Xtr=as.matrix(tr[,feats]), ytr=tr$Sales, Xte=as.matrix(te[,feats]),
       yte=te$Sales, tr=tr, te=te)
}
val_idx <- function(tr){ d<-sort(unique(tr$Date)); cut<-d[floor(length(d)*(1-VAL_FRAC))]; which(tr$Date>cut) }

pred_mean <- function(sp){ m<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store) %>% summarise(mu=mean(Sales),.groups="drop")
  gm<-mean(sp$tr$Sales); sp$te %>% left_join(m,by="Store") %>% mutate(p=coalesce(mu,gm)) %>% pull(p) }
pred_dow <- function(sp){ dm<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store,DayOfWeek) %>% summarise(md=mean(Sales),.groups="drop")
  m<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store) %>% summarise(mu=mean(Sales),.groups="drop"); gm<-mean(sp$tr$Sales)
  sp$te %>% left_join(dm,by=c("Store","DayOfWeek")) %>% left_join(m,by="Store") %>%
    mutate(p=coalesce(md,mu,gm)) %>% pull(p) }

run_xgb <- function(sp){ vi<-val_idx(sp$tr); ti<-setdiff(seq_along(sp$ytr),vi)
  pr<-list(objective="reg:squarederror",eta=0.10,max_depth=6,subsample=0.8,
           colsample_bytree=0.8,nthread=N_THREADS,verbosity=0)
  es<-xgb.train(pr,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr[ti,],label=sp$ytr[ti]),nrounds=1500,
       watchlist=list(v=xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr[vi,],label=sp$ytr[vi])),early_stopping_rounds=50,verbose=0)
  fit<-xgb.train(pr,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr,label=sp$ytr),nrounds=es$best_iteration,verbose=0)
  predict(fit,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xte)) }
run_lgb <- function(sp){ vi<-val_idx(sp$tr); ti<-setdiff(seq_along(sp$ytr),vi)
  pr<-list(objective="regression",metric="rmse",num_leaves=63,learning_rate=0.05,
           bagging_fraction=0.8,bagging_freq=1,feature_fraction=0.8,num_threads=N_THREADS,seed=SEED,verbosity=-1)
  es<-lgb.train(pr,lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr[ti,],label=sp$ytr[ti]),nrounds=2000,
       valids=list(v=lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr[vi,],label=sp$ytr[vi])),early_stopping_rounds=50,verbose=-1)
  fit<-lgb.train(pr,lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr,label=sp$ytr),nrounds=es$best_iter,verbose=-1)
  predict(fit,sp$Xte) }

score_window <- function(start, end, name) {
  sp <- split_window(df, FEAT, start, end)
  rm <- eval_rmse(sp$yte, pred_mean(sp)); rd <- eval_rmse(sp$yte, pred_dow(sp))
  rx <- eval_rmse(sp$yte, run_xgb(sp));   rl <- eval_rmse(sp$yte, run_lgb(sp))
  tibble(Window=name, test_obs=length(sp$yte), train_days=n_distinct(sp$tr$Date),
         Store_mean=round(rm), Store_DOW=round(rd), XGBoost=round(rx), LightGBM=round(rl),
         XGB_dDOW=round(delta_rel(rd,rx),1), LGB_dDOW=round(delta_rel(rd,rl),1))
}
```

# 2. Four windows, including December 2014

```{r windows, cache=TRUE}
windows <- tribble(
  ~name,                       ~start,        ~end,
  "W1 (20 Jun-31 Jul 2015)",   "2015-06-20",  "2015-07-31",
  "W2 (9 May-19 Jun 2015)",    "2015-05-09",  "2015-06-19",
  "W3 (28 Mar-8 May 2015)",    "2015-03-28",  "2015-05-08",
  "W4 (30 Nov 2014-10 Jan 2015, Christmas)", "2014-11-30", "2015-01-10"
)
rolling <- pmap_dfr(windows, function(name,start,end) score_window(start,end,name))
rolling
# Written for the thesis: Table 16, window 4 (the December peak). Windows 1 to
# 3 come from rossmann_stages2_4.Rmd.
dir.create("thesis_tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(rolling, "thesis_tables/rolling_december.csv")
```

# 3. Read-off

```{r verdict}
cat("W1-W3 should reproduce the thesis rolling table (XGBoost stochastic ~1-2%).\n")
cat("W4 is the new test: does the December peak break the advantage?\n")
cat(" - If XGB/LGBM still beat Store-DOW by a similar margin, the models generalise\n")
cat("   the Christmas peak (they have the Month feature and saw December 2013).\n")
cat(" - If the margin collapses, the spring-summer robustness did not extend to December.\n")
```
